exposure: Preterm infants categorized by gestational age at birth
Gestational age at delivery: very preterm (28-32 weeks), moderate preterm (32-34 weeks), late preterm (34-37 weeks)
Duration of first and second stages of labor
outcome: Apgar score less than 7 at 1 minute
cohort: 981 single pregnancy women with a vaginal delivery before 37 weeks of gestation
finding: The study identified several risk factors for low Apgar scores in preterm infants and developed prediction models with good accuracy for identifying high-risk infants.
